name: Steampunk Lincoln
body:
A man, strangely dressed in a tall, black hat and bizarre harness of some sort, materializes out of thin air. He takes one look at the evil horde you face and says, “Let us have faith that right makes might, and in that faith, let us, to the end, dare to do our duty as we understand it!”
Steampunk Lincoln	CR 6
XP 2,400
LN Medium humanoid ( human) expert 7
Init -1; Senses Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 8, flat-footed 19 (-1 Dex, +7 armor)
hp 31 (7d8)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +8

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 power gauntlets +7 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks steampunk harness

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con 10, Int 13, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 15
Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Iron Will, Magical Aptitude, Master Craftsman, Skill Focus (Craft [steampunk]) (B)
Skills Craft (steampunk) +16, Diplomacy +10, Disable Device +9, Knowledge (engineering) +11, Knowledge (planes) +11, Perception +11, Spellcraft +13, Use Magic Device +12; Armor Check Penalty -0
Language Celestial, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES
Steampunk Harness

Lincoln’s awesome steampunk harness combines the properties of a +1 mithral breastplate and +1 spiked gauntlets (thus, his power gauntlet melee attack). Once per day, upon command, the harness enables it wearer to plane shift (as a 9th-level cleric). Upon command, the harness projects a lightning bolt (5d6, Ref DC 14) as a 5th-level wizard.

Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot armor, hands; Price 60,405 gp; Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, lightning bolt, plane shift; Cost 30,202 gp, 5 sp.; Weight 17 lbs.

This item is well beyond the starting equipment Lincoln should have; consequently, he is CR +1.

Image used by permission of artist Brandon Herren, Psychotronik Comics.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or in the company of the Emancipators, a trio of allied adventurers
Treasure NPC gear ( steampunk harness plus 600 gp)

Abraham Lincoln, better known as Steampunk Lincoln, hails from a strange plane where magic and science developed side-by-side. In his native land, Lincoln attempted to go into politics to combat the spread of chattel slavery via legal means. Unfortunately, he was thwarted in a series of public debates and discredited by a fabricated scandal regarding his love life. Unable to gain ground in government, he returned to work as an engineer. When his nation erupted in civil war, Lincoln knew he couldn’t just stand by and do nothing. He forged his amazing steampunk harness and joined the Union to fight against the Confederacy in order to restore his beloved country and to abolish slavery.

After the Union’s victory in that war, Lincoln modified his steampunk harness so that he could travel the multiverse, doing battle against the forces of chaos and tyranny. He is often assisted by the Emancipators:
Zion Thunder, aasimar paladin
Agnar Chainbreaker, dwarf cleric
The Chanteuse, half-elf bard
